create_positional_embedding: create a SimpleSinusoidalPositionalEmbedding module with a given embedding dimension and number of embeddings
build_sinusoidal_embeddings: build sinusoidal positional embeddings using sine and cosine functions for sequence positions
forward_positional_lookup: forward pass to look up positional embeddings by index from the precomputed weight tensor
review_embedding_init: review the SimpleSinusoidalPositionalEmbedding init to understand how sinusoidal weights are computed and zero-padded for odd dimensions
test_forward_positions: test the forward method by passing position indices and verifying the returned embedding tensor shape
